questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign alerts you that traffic signals are ahead at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians pass before you go ahead. Stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign alerts you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on roadways. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until the way is clear for you to safely pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a reverse curve where the road curves right and then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to unusual conditions. This sign tells you the right lane is ending and you should prepare for merging traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you a divided highway is starting and you should stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet roads are slippery and dangerous. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop your car.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you of work zones ahead. Stay alert and be ready for unexpected driving conditions. A flagger will direct traffic, and you must follow their instructions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the road curves right first, then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Triangular signs pointing downward mean yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if necessary. If you stop, do so at the marked stop line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed at this intersection. It is illegal and unsafe to turn right here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Activate your turn signal and proceed into traffic at the usual speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means let other traffic pass first. You do not always need to stop, but always slow down and be cautious. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign at intersections with busy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed. It is a regulatory sign that enforces traffic laws.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection so you can see oncoming traffic. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. You do not need to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange and red triangle is displayed on slow-moving vehicles like tractors, road maintenance equipment, and horse-drawn carts.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers to an area where pedestrians may be crossing. Stop and wait until pedestrians completely clear the crosswalk before driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers to watch for people crossing. Be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared to stop if the light is flashing.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to respond to the signal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed limit.
The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
You must not travel below the speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign shows the maximum allowed speed. You can drive slower based on conditions, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming curve. The speed plaque suggests the safe speed to take the curve.
